name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
teBrief: యాక్సిడెంట్ ఇన్సూరెన్స్ స్కీమ్ అనేది యాక్సిడెంట్ కారణంగా మరణం లేదా వైకల్యం కోసం యాక్సిడెంటల్ డెత్ అండ్ డిసెబిలిటీ కవర్ను అందిస్తుంది.
brief: An Accident Insurance Scheme offering accidental death and disability cover for death or disability on account of an accident.
briefFull: An Accident Insurance Scheme offering accidental death and disability cover for death or disability on account of an accident.
details:
An Accident Insurance Scheme offering accidental death and disability cover for death or disability on account of an accident.
**Premium:**
Rs.20/- per annum per member. The premium will be deducted from the account holder’s bank / Post office account through ‘auto debit’ facility on or before 1st June of each annual coverage period under the scheme. 
**Coverage Duration:**
Coverage under PMJJBY is valid for one year from 1st June to 31st May on payment of annual premium.
**Accident cover assurance termination:**
The accident cover of the member shall terminate / be restricted accordingly on any of the following events:
•	On attaining age 70 years (age nearer birth day).
•	Closure of account with the Bank or insufficiency of balance to keep the insurance in force.
In case a member is covered under PMSBY through more than one account and premium is received by insurance company inadvertently, insurance cover will be restricted to Rs. 2 lakh.
benefits:
1. On Death- the Nominee shall get Rs. 2 Lakhs.
1. Total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot-  Subscriber shall get Rs. 2 Lakhs.
1. Total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot –subscriber shall get Rs. 1 Lakh.
eligibility: Individual bank account holders of participating banks aged between 18 years (completed) and 70 years (age nearer birthday) who give their consent to join / enable auto-debit, will be enrolled into the scheme.
howToApply:
[Offline]
**Step 01:** In order to enrol in PMSBY offline, one can visit the bank branch where one has a savings account or the candidate can visit the official site: [https://jansuraksha.gov.in/Forms-PMSBY.aspx](https://jansuraksha.gov.in/Forms-PMSBY.aspx)**** to download the form. 
**Step 02:** After downloading the application form , candidate can fill in all the details and submit  them to the bank along with the  required documents.
**Step 03:** Once it is successfully submitted , subscriber will get an Acknowledgement Slip Cum Certificate of Insurance.
Contact:
**State wise tollfree number** - [https://jansuraksha.gov.in/files/STATEWISETOLLFREE.pdf ](https://jansuraksha.gov.in/files/STATEWISETOLLFREE.pdf)
**National Toll Free Number** - 1800-180-1111 / 1800-110-001

[Online]
One can also avail cover under PMSBY online using their bank's Net banking facility.

1. ఒక కన్ను యొక్క మొత్తం మరియు తిరిగి పొందలేని దృష్టి నష్టం లేదా ఒక చేతి లేదా పాదం యొక్క ఉపయోగం కోల్పోవడం-చందాదారుడు రూ. 1 లక్ష.
te.howToApply:

- [https://jansuraksha.gov.in/files/STATEWISETOLLFREE.pdf](https://jansuraksha.gov.in/files/STATEWISETOLLFREE.pdf)** జాతీయ టోల్ ఫ్రీ నంబర్ -1800-180-1111/1800-110-001

[Online]

faqs.q: Is There Any Provision For Reimbursement of Hospitalization expenses following accident Resulting In Death Or Disablement?
faqs.qTe: మరణం లేదా వైకల్యానికి దారితీసిన ప్రమాదం తరువాత ఆసుపత్రి ఖర్చులను తిరిగి చెల్లించడానికి ఏదైనా నిబంధన ఉందా?

faqs.q: Who Can Claim Insurance Benefit In Case Of Death Of The Bank Account Holder Who Gave The Enrolment Form?
faqs.a: In case of death of the Account holder who enrolled in the scheme, claim can be filed by the nominee/appointee as per the enrolment form or by the legal heir/s in case there is no nomination made by the subscriber bank account holder.
faqs.qTe: నమోదు ఫారం ఇచ్చిన బ్యాంకు ఖాతాదారుడు మరణించిన సందర్భంలో బీమా ప్రయోజనాన్ని ఎవరు క్లెయిమ్ చేయవచ్చు?

faqs.q: What Is The Mode Of Payment Of The Claim Amount?
faqs.a: Disability Claim will be credited in the bank account of the insured bank account holder. Death claims will be remitted to the bank account of the nominee / legal heir(s).

faqs.q: Will The Family Get Insurance Benefit If The Account Holder Commits Suicide?
faqs.qTe: ఖాతాదారుడు ఆత్మహత్య చేసుకుంటే కుటుంబానికి బీమా ప్రయోజనం లభిస్తుందా?

faqs.q: Is It Necessary To Report Accidents To Police And Obtain FIR For Claiming Benefits Under The Policy?
faqs.a: In case of incidents like Road, Rail and similar vehicular accidents, drowning, death involving any crime etc., the accident should be reported to police. In case of incidents like snake bite, fall from tree etc., the cause should be supported by immediate hospital record.
faqs.qTe: ప్రమాదాలను పోలీసులకు నివేదించి, పాలసీ కింద ప్రయోజనాలను క్లెయిమ్ చేసినందుకు ఎఫ్ఐఆర్ పొందడం అవసరమా?

faqs.q: If The Insured Is Missing And Death Is Not Confirmed, Will The Legal Heirs Get Benefit Of Insurance?
faqs.a: PMSBY covers deaths confirmed by documentary evidence to have been caused by accident.
faqs.qTe: బీమా చేసిన వ్యక్తి తప్పిపోయినట్లయితే మరియు మరణం నిర్ధారించబడకపోతే, చట్టపరమైన వారసులు బీమా ప్రయోజనాన్ని పొందుతారా?

faqs.q: What Benefit Will Be Payable if A Person Suffers Partial Disability Without Irrecoverable Loss Of Sight Of One Eye Or Loss Of Use Of One Hand Or Foot?
faqs.qTe: ఒక వ్యక్తి ఒక కన్ను యొక్క కనిపించని నష్టం లేదా ఒక చేతి లేదా పాదం యొక్క ఉపయోగం కోల్పోకుండా పాక్షిక వైకల్యంతో బాధపడితే ఏమి ప్రయోజనం చెల్లించబడుతుంది?

faqs.q: Can An Account Holder Get Claim From More Than One Bank Where He Has Enrolled And Premium Has Been Debited?
faqs.a: No. The insured/ Nominee shall be eligible for one claim only.
faqs.qTe: ఖాతాదారుడు నమోదు చేసుకున్న మరియు ప్రీమియం డెబిట్ చేయబడిన ఒకటి కంటే ఎక్కువ బ్యాంకుల నుండి క్లెయిమ్ పొందవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Can A Individual Join PMSBY From Multiple Bank Accounts?
faqs.a: No. In case of multiple bank accounts held by an individual in one or different banks, the person would be eligible to join the scheme through one bank/post office account only.
faqs.qTe: ఒక వ్యక్తి బహుళ బ్యాంకు ఖాతాల నుండి పిఎంఎస్బివై లో చేరవచ్చా?

faqs.q: What Is The Minimum And Maximum Age Limit For Entry Into This Scheme?
faqs.a: Individuals aged between 18 years (completed) and 70 years (age nearer birthday) are eligible for this scheme.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకంలో ప్రవేశానికి కనీస, గరిష్ట వయోపరిమితి ఎంత?

faqs.q: How Will The Premium Be Paid?
faqs.a: The premium will be deducted from the account holder's bank / Post office account through 'auto debit' as per the consent given on enrolment.

faqs.q: Can Eligible Individuals Who Fail To Join The Scheme In The Initial Year Join In Subsequent Years?
faqs.a: Yes, on payment of premium through auto-debit. New eligible entrants in future years can also join accordingly.
faqs.qTe: ప్రారంభ సంవత్సరంలో ఈ పథకంలో చేరడంలో విఫలమైన అర్హతగల వ్యక్తులు తరువాతి సంవత్సరాల్లో చేరవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Can Individuals Who Leave The Scheme Rejoin?
faqs.a: Individuals who exit the scheme at any point may re-join the scheme in future years by paying the annual premium, subject to conditions that may be laid down.

faqs.q: Will This Cover Be In Addition To Cover Under Any Other Insurance Scheme The Subscriber May Be Covered Under?
faqs.qTe: ఈ కవర్ చందాదారుడు కవర్ చేయగల ఏదైనా ఇతర బీమా పథకం కింద కవర్ చేయడానికి అదనంగా ఉంటుందా?

faqs.q: Does The PMSBY Cover Death / Disability Resulting From Natural Calamities Such As Earthquake, Flood And Other Convulsions Of Nature? What about coverage of suicide / murder?
faqs.a: Natural calamities being in the nature of accidents, any death / disability (as defined under PMSBY) resulting from such natural calamities is also covered under PMSBY. While death due to suicide is not covered, that from murder is covered
faqs.qTe: భూకంపాలు, వరదలు మరియు ఇతర ప్రకృతి వైపరీత్యాల వంటి ప్రకృతి వైపరీత్యాల వల్ల సంభవించే మరణాలు/వైకల్యాన్ని పిఎంఎస్బివై కవర్ చేస్తుందా? ఆత్మహత్య/హత్య గురించి కవరేజ్ గురించి ఏమిటి?

faqs.q: Can All Holders Of A Joint Bank Account Join The Scheme Through The Said Account?
faqs.a: In case of a joint account, all holders of the said account can join the scheme provided they satisfy its eligibility criteria and pay the premium at the rate of Rs.20 per person, per annum through auto-debit.
faqs.qTe: ఉమ్మడి బ్యాంకు ఖాతాను కలిగి ఉన్న వారందరూ ఆ ఖాతా ద్వారా ఈ పథకంలో చేరవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Which Bank Accounts Are Eligible For Subscribing To PMSBY?
faqs.a: All bank/post office account holders other than institutional account holders are eligible for subscribing to PMSBY scheme.
faqs.qTe: పి. ఎం. ఎస్. బి. వై. కి సభ్యత్వాన్ని పొందడానికి ఏ బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలు అర్హులు?

faqs.q: Are NRIs Eligible For Coverage Under PMSBY?
faqs.a: Any NRI having an eligible bank account with a bank branch located in India is eligible for purchase of PMSBY cover through this account subject to fulfilment of the terms and conditions relating to the scheme. However, in cases of a claim , the claim benefit will be paid to the beneficiary/ nominee only in Indian currency.
